unsupported: Campofrio Food Group America, headquartered in South Chesterfield, Virginia, operates as the U.S. arm of Sigma Foods, a multinational food company that produces, markets, and distributes cold meats, cured meats, dairy products, and other food items across Mexico, Europe, the United States, and Latin America.
